han14.risk: CJK unified ideographs; no combining marks, controls or surrogate pairs.

east15.risk: Assigned CJK ideographs and Hangul syllables. NFC/NFKC stable; NFD decomposes Hangul and can be repaired with NFC.

assigned.risk: Assigned letters, numbers, punctuation and symbols stable under NFC/NFKC, excluding combining jamo. Frozen to Unicode 15.0.0. Still includes RTL letters and uncommon scripts.

dense.risk: Diagnostic only: includes private-use, unassigned, combining and normalization-sensitive characters. Excludes surrogates, controls, format characters, whitespace, percent, quotes and selected URL delimiters. Not safe to recommend for game chat.
